data.why: example_2 is the repository's own CC0 validation dataset: five timed 96-well plate workbooks, a plate-group map, a reloadable analysis-settings JSON, and expected numerical results, exactly matching the documented workflow in example_2/README.md.

goals: Load a batch of plate-reader Excel workbooks and confirm the rows, columns, and numeric values were parsed correctly
Group wells into experimental conditions using a reusable plate-map template and aggregate replicate measurements
Remove outlier readings with a chosen method (IQR, Z-score, or MAD) and inspect the outlier log for transparency
Run a Welch t-test between two treatment groups and check the pairwise p-value matrix across time points
Visualize the time-course response of each group with error bars (e.g. 95% CI) to compare conditions at a glance
Export a complete Excel report bundling aggregated data, statistics, t-tests, charts, and provenance for recordkeeping

review.summary: The tree describes PlateMaster accurately: batch import with a preview, plate-map grouping, outlier filtering with a log, Welch and pairwise tests, time-course plots, and an Excel export with saved settings. The screens I opened and the repo's expected results support it. Before filing it needs a few fixes: correct the misread 'по' (by) plot labels, move the restore-settings task into the reuse phase, add tasks for choosing rows/columns and the aggregation function, add features for the descriptive statistics card and the report export, and replace one citation that doesn't show what it claims.
